title: The Arazzo catalogue's two specification extensions
description: `x-veredictum-cite` sits on a workflow, a step or a criterion; a criterion without one inherits its step's, and a step its workflow's. `x-veredictum-check` sits on a criterion only, for the judgements no standard Arazzo criterion can express. `validate` also checks that a citation's quote occurs, after whitespace normalization, inside the named section of the named vendored file, which no schema can state.

source.description: The vendored released file, relative to the repository root.

section.description: A top-level key or a JSON Pointer in a YAML source. In a Markdown or AsciiDoc source, the title of exactly one heading, or a path of titles joined by ` > ` in which each heading sits directly under the one before it; a title that matches more than one heading is refused.

quote.description: The sentence that assigns the expectation, copied verbatim.

report.description: The upstream-report issue in this repository that records a defect, contradiction or silence in the cited text.
